name: Ecchi na Oshigoto ~Omase na Shoujo no Okozukai Kasegi~
original_name: えっちなおしごと～おませな少女のお小遣い稼ぎ～
source:
When pretty little Nao Minami breaks a vase,
she has to pay for it with money earned from sex.
However, all she knows about sex is from dirty manga.
Can she earn the cash to pay her debt......?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ179880.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
